parts.playback_instruction: Fit the four holders and their matching pins; compare all three close-ups on manual page 11.
Press the matching pins into the holders as illustrated on manual page 11.
Fit the two rear brackets at the locations shown on manual page 14.
Approach the rear fitting. The printed turning action is not animated; follow manual page 16.
Position the washer in the orientation shown on manual page 19. Wall screws and wall fastening are not animated.
Fit the cover only after the cabinet is secured according to manual page 19. Cover turning/locking is not animated.
